_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 09:47 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT, AFTER A SCOPE PREFLIGHT THAT MATCHED THE MANDATE IDENTIFIER EXACTLY as a string against the connector list - no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic. Every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match - unchanged from every read since 8/27 because nothing has traded in six sessions. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and no option no-fly window is reachable; that is discharged by evidence rather than excused, and it is settled BEFORE any entry is reasoned about because exits outrank entries. Equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-26 return an empty list, which independently confirms the flatness is not a stale read carried across the weekend. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so no good-faith violation is reachable and this entry sizes against the full 1009.16 as read this morning rather than against a number carried from Friday. THE OPEN FIRED 09:47 AGAINST A 09:33 SLOT - FOURTEEN MINUTES LATE, inside the 25-minute guard in both directions - so unlike Friday, when the open arrived 116 minutes late and correctly declined, the daily entry mandate is reachable today and is discharged with a CLEAN entry rather than a forced one. THE SPECIFICATION IS 3 SJM AT A 132.10 LIMIT, cost 396.30, which is 39.27% of the account against the 40% single-name ceiling - inside it by 7.36 dollars, and the size was chosen to fit the ceiling rather than the ceiling read to fit the size. THERE IS ONE OPEN SPECIFICATION AND NO OPEN POSITION, so the four-name book ceiling and the two-per-complex limit are both trivially satisfied, and the mandate's own maxPositions of 2 is not approached.

entryWatch.setup: SJM breakout pullback - J.M. Smucker reported fiscal Q1 2027 on 2026-08-26 before the open, EPS 3.24 against a 2.22 estimate, a 45.9% beat, and the three sessions since are a textbook hold rather than a fade: the 8/26 gap ran to 134.85, sold to 128.12 and still closed 130.90 against a 125.45 pre-print close; 8/27 took out the day-one high at 135.89 and closed higher at 131.84; 8/28 was a narrow inside-range bar, low 131.10, close 132.34. Four consecutive higher closes on a rising sequence of lows - 128.12, 128.90, 131.10, 131.645 - while volume decayed from 2.86M to 2.13M to 1.45M, which is what a consolidation is supposed to look like and what a distribution is not. SPECIFIED at 09:47 at a 132.10 limit for 3 shares, CLEAN - no checklist item marked fail.
entryWatch.trigger: LIVE AND ARMED UNTIL 15:30 ET TODAY. SJM is 132.42 bid / 132.80 ask at 2026-08-31T13:46:34.733795390Z, last 132.878, +0.06% on the bid against a 132.34 settled close, on a 0.29% spread. The 132.10 limit sits 0.32 or 0.24% BELOW the live bid, so this is a buy on a shallow give-back rather than a lift of the offer, and the level is demonstrably reachable rather than hopeful: SJM opened 131.645 this morning and 132.10 traded inside the 09:30-09:35 bar. WHAT KILLS THIS THESIS, stated now so a run at 13:00 that was not here at 09:47 can check it against the tape without re-deriving it: a trade below 131.10, the 8/28 session low, breaks the rising-lows sequence the entire setup rests on; a close below 131.10 ends it outright. Those are the invalidations. The -8% mechanical stop at 121.53 is the rulebook's number and is DELIBERATELY LOOSER than the structural one - it sits below the 125.45 pre-print close, meaning the mechanical stop only triggers after the whole earnings gap has been given back, and the thesis will have died at 131.10 long before the stop is reached. Both numbers are written down; they are not the same number and are not pretended to be.
entryWatch.why: Item 1 is a dated number, not a chart: SJM reported fiscal Q1 2027 on 2026-08-26 am, EPS 3.24 against a 2.22 estimate, a 45.9% beat, verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-26 to 2026-08-28. Item 2 passes on BOTH limbs and is not waved through on one. The entry is +0.06% on the bid and three sessions past the reaction bar, nowhere near the +8% line and not the spike the rulebook refuses. The second limb - the whole-list-green wait signal - fires the OPPOSITE way today: the tape is RED, SPY 765.82 bid against a 769.35 close for -0.46%, and the post-earnings cohort is being sold hard, GAP -4.51%, WSM -3.87%, RBRK -3.42%, BURL -2.91%, BBY -2.81%, WDAY -2.31%. A defensive staple holding a gap while the discretionary names that beat alongside it are unwound is the relative-strength read this setup wants, and it is the reason SJM and not one of them. Item 3 does not bind and is logged na rather than skipped: a live forward earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-06 returns no SJM, its print is three sessions behind it, and its next report is not inside the five-session time stop - so there is no earnings hold for a straddle to precede and none is invented. The AVGO 9/2 row in moves.json is checked rather than assumed away: branch one binds AVGO itself and semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy names, and packaged food is neither and carries no read-through from a semiconductor print. Item 4 is the weakest reading on this entry and is recorded as such rather than rounded up: the spread is 0.29% of mark, which is real but is three to ten times wider than the names this board usually likes - BOX quoted 0.028% and ANET 0.103% - and the first eighteen minutes of today's tape are thin at roughly 5,200 shares. Against that, market cap is meaningful, and the three post-print sessions traded 2.86M, 2.13M and 1.45M shares against 0.84M-1.43M in the week before, which is real volume by any reading. The 38-cent spread costs 1.4% of the 26.42-dollar move to target - a genuine cost, named with a number so it can be argued with. Item 5 reads the right way and is the quiet strength of this entry: SJM was NOT run up into its print. It closed 123.05, 124.32, 125.87 and 125.45 in the four sessions before reporting, mid-range and unloved, and then beat by 45.9%. Crowded bulls into a raised bar is the failure mode item 5 watches for; a large beat on a name nobody was positioned in is its mirror image. Item 6 is discharged here in writing before entry: target 158.52, stop 121.53, time stop the 9/4 close, and the thesis invalidation at 131.10 named separately from the stop.

entryWatch.setup: BOX post-earnings continuation - the 8/27 specification at a 34.50 limit that expired unexecuted
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND NOT RE-STRUCK FOR THE TWELFTH TIME. BOX is 35.06 bid / 35.11 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:06.451500218Z, last 35.100, +0.23% against a 34.980 settled close, leaving the dead 34.50 limit 0.56 or 1.60% BELOW the market. Widening the time was never permission to widen the price, and that rule does not stop applying because the level stayed close. AND THE TAPE ADDS A SECOND REASON THIS WEEKEND: 8/28 was a REVERSAL bar, opening 34.75, running to 36.16 and closing 34.98 back near its own low, so the name spent Friday giving back a 3.4% intraday gain. The setup that justified 34.50 on 8/27 - the day-two continuation of a 17.6% beat - is now four sessions old and its most recent bar is a rejection. It is refused on price and it is no longer the same setup.
entryWatch.why: The 8/27 entry was CLEAN, no item marked fail, and it was re-quoted and confirmed six times before it died at 15:30 that day. None of that makes 35.06 an entry. This row is kept dead rather than deleted because the refusal is the record: BOX has been refused at 36.11, 35.70, 35.59, 35.58, 35.35, 35.24 and now 35.06, and a refusal that only holds while the level runs away is a preference that happened to be cheap.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC day-2 after the 8/25 print - the 8/26 specification at a 138.50 limit that expired unexecuted
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THE REFUSAL IS NOW VINDICATED BY A NUMBER RATHER THAN BY AN ARGUMENT. SMTC is 131.95 bid / 132.88 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:05.752050223Z, +0.59% against a 131.17 settled close. On 8/27 this board refused to re-strike the dead 138.50 limit up to 144.20 and wrote that the refusal would be graded whichever way it went; SMTC then settled 131.17 on 8/28, a 9.0% single-session decline, so the refusal was worth 12.25 a share or 8.5% against the price the mandate would otherwise have paid. THAT IS THE POINT WORTH KEEPING, and it cuts the other way from the BOX miss: the same rule that cost this board a filled BOX entry saved it a filled SMTC entry, and only counting one of those is how a process talks itself out of a rule. The name is still not bought here - 131.95 is neither the dead level nor a fresh setup, the print is four sessions behind it, and the semiconductor complex carries the 9/2 AVGO print inside any five-session hold opened today.
entryWatch.why: Unchanged and not re-argued: a 24.6% beat on a name marked down 21.6% into its own print. The thesis was never the problem; the delivery was, and then the price was.

candidatesNote: EVERY ROW BELOW WAS QUOTED LIVE THIS MORNING BETWEEN 09:41 AND 09:47 ET - there is no row carried from a previous session and no timestamp a reader has to discount. THE TAPE IS RED: SPY 765.82 bid against a 769.35 close, -0.46%, and the breadth inside the post-earnings cohort is worse than the index, with GAP -4.51%, WSM -3.87%, RBRK -3.42%, BURL -2.91%, BBY -2.81% and WDAY -2.31% all lower on their own beats. That matters for item 2's second limb, which asks whether the whole list is green as a wait signal; it is not, so the limb passes rather than being waved through. NO EXIT WAS DUE: equity and option positions were both queried live and both returned empty, so no target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable - the reason is that nothing is held, not that nothing was checked, and that was settled before any entry was reasoned about. THE WEEK'S CALENDAR IS THE SHAPE OF THIS LIST. A live forward pull covering 8/31 to 9/6 returns PANW, DELL, CRDO, MDB and GTLB on 9/1 pm; SNOW, HPE, NTAP, AI and AVGO on 9/2 pm; and ZS, DOCU, GWRE, PATH, IOT and ASAN on 9/3 pm. Any five-session hold opened today expires 9/4 and therefore sits through all of it, so semiconductors and enterprise software are refused as a bloc under moves.json branch one - a rule written 2026-08-21 and applied here to a new date rather than rediscovered. That refusal is what pushed this run OUT of the complex it has traded all month and into a consumer staple, and the entry is better for it rather than a consolation. THE TWO BEST-LOOKING SETUPS WERE REFUSED ON THEIR OWN NUMBERS. ULTA reported 8/27 pm and beat, and its day-one bar on 8/28 opened 542.00, printed a 503.05 low and closed 517.50, a 4.55% DECLINE on 1.61M shares against 0.61-0.72M typical - a beat the market sold, which is the exact ZM refusal from 8/27, and today's +3.36% is a bounce off that decline rather than a continuation of anything. One share would also be 53.0% of the account against a 40% ceiling, so it is blocked twice over. SAIC posted the largest beat on the board at 30.9% and is refused because the reaction is failing IN FRONT OF THIS RUN: it opened 140.39, printed 142.66 in the first five minutes and had traded 132.15 by 09:35, giving back the entire gap, which is the NTNX gap-and-fade refusal made on 8/27 and there is no shelf to strike a limit at because the name has not stopped going down. WHAT WAS TAKEN IS THE ONE SETUP WHOSE POST-PRINT SESSIONS ACTUALLY HELD.

candidates.note: THE ENTRY. 132.42 bid / 132.80 ask at 2026-08-31T13:46:34.733795390Z, last 132.878, +0.06% on the bid against a 132.34 settled close, on a 0.29% spread. Fiscal Q1 2027 reported 2026-08-26 am, EPS 3.24 against 2.22, a 45.9% beat, verified on a live calendar pull. THE THREE SESSIONS SINCE ARE THE WHOLE ARGUMENT: 8/26 gapped to 134.85, sold to 128.12 and closed 130.90 against a 125.45 pre-print close; 8/27 took out the day-one high at 135.89 and closed 131.84; 8/28 was a narrow inside bar, 131.10 to 134.40, closing 132.34. Four higher closes, lows rising 128.12, 128.90, 131.10, 131.645, volume decaying 2.86M, 2.13M, 1.45M. A consolidation gives back its volume and holds its lows; a distribution gives back its price. This gave back volume. SPECIFIED at 3 shares at a 132.10 limit, 396.30 or 39.27% of the account, target 158.52, stop 121.53, time stop the 9/4 close, invalidation 131.10. Item 4 is the weak leg and is named: the 0.29% spread is wide against this board's usual 0.03-0.10%, and today's first eighteen minutes are thin at roughly 5,200 shares.

534.88 bid / 537.01 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:48.217032144Z, +3.36% against a 517.50 close. REFUSED TWICE OVER, EITHER SUFFICIENT. First, on shape: it beat 6.55 against 6.25 and the market SOLD it, the 8/28 day-one bar opening 542.00, printing a 503.05 low and closing 517.50 for a 4.55% decline on 1.61M shares against 0.61-0.72M typical. A beat the tape sells is a guidance or mix problem this run cannot see, and today's +3.36% is a bounce off that decline, not a continuation - which is precisely the ZM refusal made on 8/27 and it is applied here identically. Second, on arithmetic: one share is 53.0% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling, so there is no size at which this is proposable. Recorded because it was the best-looking day-2 candidate on the calendar and losing it to its own tape is the finding.

133.96 bid / 134.63 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:50.94792511Z, +6.35% against a 125.96 close. THE LARGEST BEAT ON THE BOARD - 3.01 against 2.30, up 30.9%, reported this morning - AND REFUSED, on the day-one reaction bar and on what that bar is doing while this run watches it. The 5-minute tape: 09:30 opened 140.39, high 142.66, low 132.15 on 98,103 shares; 09:35 opened 135.00 and closed 132.88. It has given back nearly the whole gap inside twelve minutes on heavy volume. That is a gap-and-fade IN PROGRESS, which is the NTNX refusal of 8/27 word for word, and there is no shelf to strike a limit at because the name has not stopped going down. Note the number that does NOT do the refusing: +6.35% is under the +8% line, so item 2's numeric limb would have passed and the refusal rests on structure instead - the rulebook says the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is. WORTH THE 9/1 AND 9/2 OPENS' ATTENTION if it builds a shelf: the catalyst is the biggest on the tape, defence-IT sits outside the semiconductor and software complex the calendar has mined this week, and 3 shares would fit the 40% ceiling at any limit up to 134.55.

35.06 bid / 35.11 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:06.451500218Z, +0.23% against a 34.980 close, on a 0.14% spread - still the tightest quote in this list. NOT RE-STRUCK FOR THE TWELFTH TIME. The dead 34.50 limit is 1.60% under the market and re-striking a dead level higher is the refusal this board has made more often than any other. What is NEW this reading is that the tape has stopped arguing for it: 8/28 opened 34.75, ran to 36.16 and closed 34.98 back near its low, a reversal bar that gave back a 3.4% intraday gain, so the day-two continuation thesis is now four sessions old and its latest bar is a rejection. Flag stays watch rather than nofly because the name carries no blocking event and its print is behind it - it is simply not buyable by this board at this price.

124.77 bid / 125.04 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:06.071847432Z, +1.53% against a 122.890 close. A 12.1% beat that the tape has ROUND-TRIPPED IN FULL, which is why it lost to SJM on the same setup. 8/27 opened 127.84, printed 132.50 and closed 125.89; 8/28 opened 125.25, printed 121.34 and closed 122.89 - eleven cents above the 122.78 pre-print close. The entire earnings move is gone, so today's +1.53% is a bounce off a completed give-back rather than a pullback within a move that held. Compare SJM directly: same calendar week, same gap-and-fade day one, but SJM's lows rose every session and it closed higher four times while DG closed back at its starting point. That difference is the entire reason one was published and the other was not, and it is the same distinction that separated BOX from ZM on 8/27.

131.95 bid / 132.88 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:05.752050223Z, +0.59% against a 131.170 close. THE REFUSAL THAT PAID. On 8/27 this board declined to re-strike its dead 138.50 limit up to 144.20; SMTC settled 131.17 on 8/28, a 9.0% single-session fall, so the refusal was worth 8.5% against the price the mandate would otherwise have paid. Recorded because the same rule cost this board a filled BOX entry, and a process that only counts the times a rule cost it is on its way to repealing the rule. Still not bought: the semiconductor complex carries the 9/2 AVGO print inside any five-session hold opened today, under moves.json branch one.

366.70 bid / 366.90 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:06.5453136Z, -0.57% against a 368.790 close and DOWN 1.71 from the 368.41 the 8/28 pre-close wrote into moves.json. Refused, on a dated ground rather than a view: AVGO reports 2026-09-02 after the close, re-verified true on a live forward calendar pull covering 8/31 to 9/6 with an estimate of 3.16 and no actual, which falls INSIDE the five-session time stop of anything opened today. THE 9/3 OPEN OWNS PRUNING THE moves.json ROW and this run did not touch it - the spot there is Friday's and is 1.71 stale, which is noted rather than silently corrected, because the pre-close is the slot that re-reads it. One share is 36.3% of the account, inside the 40% ceiling, so it is the event and not the arithmetic doing the refusing here.

195.55 bid / 196.27 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:05.708898571Z, +0.09% against a 195.380 close. WORTH READING AS A GRADED REFUSAL, NOT A ROW. On 8/27 this board called ANET the best setup on the tape, refused it under moves.json branch one into the MRVL print, and recorded the intended entry so the refusal could be marked: 1 share at 202.25, stop 186.07. ANET has since closed 195.38 and is 195.55 bid, so the refused entry would be DOWN 3.31% - the branch was right on this one, where the same class of rule was wrong on BOX. It is refused again today on the same branch, now pointed at the 9/1-9/2 cluster: the AI-datacentre read-through that is the whole ANET thesis is the same read-through that makes it wear a DELL, AVGO, HPE and NTAP week.

229.83 bid / 229.94 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:50.582788438Z, +5.23% against a 218.400 close on a 0.05% spread - the strongest green print in the post-earnings cohort and the only large move up on a red tape. Refused on the calendar rather than on the chart: this is a security-software name and PANW reports 9/1 pm with ZS on 9/3 pm, both inside the five-session window, so branch one binds. It is also a fourth-session move rather than a pullback - the 8/26 print is three sessions behind and today is a fresh 5% leg, which is the spike item 2 refuses, not the give-back it buys. Two independent reasons, either sufficient.

265.00 bid / 265.74 ask at 2026-08-31T13:42:44.125732752Z, -2.91% against a 272.950 close. A 19.7% beat being sold for a third straight session: 8/27 closed 290.00 off a 306.38 open, 8/28 closed 272.95 off a 291.30 open, and today is lower again. Down 13.5% from the pre-print 313.99 close. This is the falling knife the rulebook's averaging-down clause exists for, and it is listed to make the point that the retail cohort's beats are being rejected as a group - BURL, BBY, WSM, GAP and ANF are all red today on their own good numbers, which is the read-across that kept this run out of retail entirely.
